name: Automations
description: Rules that react to what happens in the shop: when something changes about an order, wait if you like, check the conditions, then act — today by sending a webhook you compose yourself. One rule engine replaces the class of integration modules that only ever POST JSON somewhere: analytics, a chat notification, Make/Zapier, a CRM lead.

settings.label: Request timeout, seconds
settings.help: How long a webhook may take before it counts as failed. Runs happen in the queue, so this never delays a customer — but a receiver that hangs would hold a worker.

settings.label: Allow requests to private addresses
settings.help: Off by default and should stay off in production: the URL is written by an admin but the request is made by the server, from inside your network. With this off, localhost, link-local (169.254.x — cloud metadata) and private ranges are refused. Turn it on only on a development machine talking to a local receiver.

settings.label: Keep the run log, days
settings.help: Older entries are deleted nightly. The log is what tells you whether the receiver actually got it, so keep enough of it to answer that after a weekend.
